Antecedentes Clínicos:
Rodilla traumática. Esguince medial. Obs. Lesión del LCA.
Hallazgos:
Aumento de señal sugiriendo transformación quística parcial del LCA, sin criterios que sugieran
una rotura categórica. LCP y ligamentos colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos categóricos de rotura.
Úlcera condral de espesor total de la región central posterior del cóndilo femoral medial con
cambios óseos secundarios. Mide aproximadamente 2 x 3 mm.
Foco de edema óseo de la región postero central del platillo tibial lateral con pequeña fractura
trabecular regional. No se observan otras alteraciones de señal de la médula ósea. No se
observan otras alteraciones condrales de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemorales.
Leve derrame articular con sinovitis difusa. Quiste poplíteo con discreta filtración hacia caudal.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Aumento de señal sugieren transformación quística parcial del LCA. No hay signos categóricos de
rotura.
Condropatía focal grado 4 de la región central posterior del cóndilo femoral medial.
Foco edema óseo la región postero central del platillo tibial lateral con pequeña fractura trabecular
regional.
Leve derrame articular con sinovitis difusa. Quiste poplíteo con fenómenos de filtración

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

* Irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage with spur formation and subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts , more prominent at lateral femoral condyle; tiny subchondral cyst in medial tibial plateau.
* Wearing of articular cartilage of patella, major at medial facet and patellar ridge, reflecting grade 3 chondromalacia.
   Laxity of medial patellar retinaculum
> The contour of ACL and MCL in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of gade 1 injury
> The contour of PCL and LCL within normal
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, R/O paratendinitis.
> Tendinosis of quadriceps tendon.

Impression:
1. Osteoarthritis of left knee joint, major at lateral femorotibial joint and patellofemoral joint.
2. R/O grade 2 injury of medial patellar retinaculum.
3. Mild synovitis of left knee.
4. R/O paratendinitis of pes anserinus.
5. Grade 1 injury of ACL and MCL.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left anterior knee pain , hx of torn meniscus over 2 years ago, pain gets worse when walking up/ down the steps, assess for meniscus tear, SH 

Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Subarticular cysts and erosions are seen involving the medial tibial plateau. Tricompartmental arthritic changes in the form of reduced medial tibiofemoral joint space with subjacent marrow edema, thinning of the cartilage and marginal osteophytes.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. A fluid-filled distended synovial-lined lesion is seen arising in the popliteal fossa between the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus tendons measuring approximately 3 x 1.5 x 3 cm in maximum dimensions. Findings indicate Baker's cyst. No signs of infection or rupture is visualized.
MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Reduced patellofemoral joint space with subchondral erosions and thinning of the cartilage. 
Insall Salvati ratio is 1.3 indicating mild patella alta.
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Baker's cyst as described above.
2.	Tricompartmental arthritic changes in the form of reduced medial tibiofemoral joint space with subjacent marrow edema, thinning of the cartilage and marginal osteophytes.
3.	Mild patella alta.
4.	No meniscal tears could be visualized.

МР находка: Няма данни за ставен излив ставен излив. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става, са с нормална форма и структура и нехомогенен сигнален интензитет. МР данни за дифузен костномозъчен едем метаепифизарно в предната половина на тибията. Артикулиращият хрущял покриващ ставните повърхности е със запазена цялост, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Визуализира се лезия с кос ход в заден рог на медиален менискус и висок сигнален интензитет , която достига до артикулиращия хрущял на тибията. Промените са както при руптура на мениск -grade III. Запазена структура и сигнален интензитет на преден рог на медиален менискус и на латерален менискус. Кръстните връзки и колатералните лигаменти със запазена цялост и сигнална характерстика. Ретинакулуми – без особености. Мастната тъкан на Хофа е с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Заключение: МР данни за руптура на заден рог на медиален мениск - grade III.  Посттравматичен костномозъчен едем на тибията.
